Example Corp Q3 earnings call excerpt (fixture)

CEO: We continue to see revenue growth from AI servers in North America and Europe.
CFO guidance: mid-single-digit growth; no change to long-term WACC assumptions.
Gross margin outlook remains under pricing pressure in the consumer segment.
CapEx will focus on capacity expansion; dividends stay stable this year.
Key risks include customer concentration and FX volatility versus the US dollar.
Management does not provide a specific share-repurchase dollar amount in this call.
